content:
maya: quick UX pass on Security > Retention & Keys. a few small but blocking nits from today's review — mostly copy, focus, and tiny accessibility fixes.

dan: list them out pls.

maya: 1) retention presets like "30 / 90 / 365" lack units; change to "30 days" etc. 2) retention label reads "Retention"  prefer "Retention period". 3) region dropdown shows "US" as default with no explanation; testers assumed it was their selection. add helper text: "Defaulted from billing region (changeable)".

liam: i can surface units and update label quickly. region hint is fine. note: changing region may invalidate keys — add inline non-blocking warning.

anya: accessibility: KMS ownership pill fails contrast in light mode (text ratio ~3.6). switch to outline + stronger text color. also make the pill keyboard-focusable and provide an aria-label that reads "Key ownership: customer-managed".

kevin: audit log copy: instead of "key rotated" use "Encryption key rotated by [user]" and include timezone suffix like "UTC". ops asked for consistent timestamps.

maya: good. prefer "2026-04-15 14:22:00 UTC" format for logs.

liam: backend stores ISO already; i'll append " UTC" in rendering and update audit row formatter. will implement focusable pill as a <button> to host aria and keyboard events.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/PR/2099  includes copy + pill changes. CI pending.

maya: thanks. action items: liam implement UI + UTC suffix, anya run quick a11y sweep after PR, kevin update release notes, dan verify docs link for region impact.

dan: will add docs link to the region warning.

maya: aim for next patch release. ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
